lessons.lesson: All Flutter features use presentation-only architecture (no domain/data layers). Business logic is inline in pages or providers.
lessons.evidence: All mobile_customer and mobile_partner features have only presentation/pages/ folders

lessons.lesson: Zero test coverage across all platforms. No unit, widget, or integration tests exist.
Backend has 96 endpoints across 14 controllers. Public endpoints (15) are permitAll, rest require JWT.
lessons.evidence: api_contracts.json shows 13 modules with endpoint details

lessons.lesson: Profile edit in mobile_customer is local-only (no API call). Reviews have no create/report UI.
web_public supports guest booking (no auth required). web_provider has 11 booking status states.
